pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

partnerSkill.name: Mad Eye Lunge
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Eye of Cthulhu charges and attacks targeted enemy.

pals.name: Demon Eye
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

partnerSkill.name: Demonic Sight
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Chikipi
pals.summary: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside Lamball . No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.

partnerSkill.name: Egg Layer
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes lays an Egg when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Teafant
pals.summary: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.

partnerSkill.name: Soothing Shower
partnerSkill.description: While in party, restores (20~40)% of the player's Health when Health falls below 30%. (Does not stack) (120-second cooldown after activation)

pals.name: Vixy
pals.summary: The idol of Palpagos Island. If you bully a Vixy , you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.

partnerSkill.name: Dig Here!
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Lamball
pals.summary: A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down. This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, making it easy to capture and kill. As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom of the food chain itself.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Shield
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and becomes a shield. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Mau
pals.summary: Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails bring good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who were poached as a result, they were anything but.

partnerSkill.name: Gold Digger
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Jolthog
pals.summary: It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack. The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts, making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips Jolthog to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Electric explosion upon impact.

pals.name: Lifmunk
pals.summary: Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.

partnerSkill.name: Lifmunk Recoil
partnerSkill.description: When activated, leaps onto the player's head and uses a submachine gun to follows up player attacks.

pals.name: Sparkit
pals.summary: During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies.

partnerSkill.name: Static Electricity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Electric Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Electric Organ when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Depresso
pals.summary: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack.

partnerSkill.name: Caffeine Inoculation
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Depresso chugs an entire energy drink, increasing its Movement Speed and Work Speed by (100~900)% . Sometimes drops Venom Gland when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Foxparks
pals.summary: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Fire
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower.

pals.name: Fuack
pals.summary: Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere. It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision.

partnerSkill.name: Surfing Slam
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Fuack body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.

pals.name: Clovee
pals.summary: Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads. Regarded as symbols of good fortune, those with more leaves were heavily hunted, leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.

partnerSkill.name: Happy Clover
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Gathering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Pengullet

spawns.location: Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 114,-352

pals.summary: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher to fire Pengullet as ammunition. Pengullet explodes on impact and is incapacitated.

pals.name: Gumoss
pals.summary: A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.

partnerSkill.name: Logging Assistance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves logging efficiency by (30~50)% and reduces weight of all types of wood by (40~60)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Hoocrates
pals.summary: Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. |I think, therefore I am.|

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knowledge
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Pupperai
pals.summary: Pupperai territorial disputes begin with a staredown and end in a single, quick strike. Training them to |stay| is risky business, as the |go| command triggers that same attack instinct.

partnerSkill.name: Best Boy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's melee weapon damage by (10~35)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Nox
pals.summary: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.

partnerSkill.name: Kuudere
partnerSkill.description: When activated, detects the location of nearby Pal Effigies .

pals.name: Daedream
pals.summary: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.

partnerSkill.name: Dream Chaser
partnerSkill.description: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Dark magic bullets. These bullets will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

pals.name: Tanzee
pals.summary: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something slightly more effective: guns.

partnerSkill.name: Cheery Rifle
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Tanzee will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

pals.name: Cremis
pals.summary: Compared to Lamball , it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication. However, it has historically always been kept as a pet. Cuteness is considered a virtue.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Wool
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Rushoar
pals.summary: Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength. Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.

partnerSkill.name: Hard Head
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases efficiency of destroying Stone by (500~2000)% .

pals.name: Rooby
pals.summary: Wild Rooby surprisingly never get sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.

partnerSkill.name: Tiny Spark
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of Fire Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Ribbuny
pals.summary: A Pal that's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by Cattiva 's pranks. During those moments, its expression turns demonic.

partnerSkill.name: Happy-Go-Lucky Bunny
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack) While at a base, increases the Handiwork Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Jolthog Cryst
pals.summary: It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker's body.

partnerSkill.name: Cold Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips Jolthog Cryst to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Ice explosion upon impact.

pals.name: Swee
pals.summary: Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack and Defense of Sweepa .

pals.name: Tanzee Ignis
pals.summary: Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.

partnerSkill.name: Chipper Chimp Gunfire
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Tanzee Ignis will mercilessly fire a Fire assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

pals.name: Woolipop
pals.summary: Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Candy Pop
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch . While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by (-10~-20)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Kelpsea
pals.summary: Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.

partnerSkill.name: Aqua Spout
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Water Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Aquatic Pal Fluids when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Mozzarina
pals.summary: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.

partnerSkill.name: Milk Maker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Milk when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Fuddler
pals.summary: Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.

partnerSkill.name: Mining Assistance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves player mining efficiency by (30~60)% and reduces Stone weight by (80~100)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Hangyu
pals.summary: Its gigantic arms can rip apart even iron. As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals would be strung up in a public square, and a Hangyu would tear the skin right from their bones.

partnerSkill.name: Flying Trapeze
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding.

pals.name: Killamari
pals.summary: It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides. Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact Killamari victims.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Squid
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.

pals.name: Cattiva
pals.summary: At a glance it appears full of confidence, but it is in fact weak and cowardly. Being toyed with by a Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.

partnerSkill.name: Cat Helper
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Cattiva helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity by (100~200) . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Mau Cryst
pals.summary: Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise them, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Whispers
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Celaray
pals.summary: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey's end.

partnerSkill.name: Zephyr Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.

pals.name: Tocotoco

spawns.location: Map Sealed Realm of the Swift 349,-2

pals.summary: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.

partnerSkill.name: Eggbomb Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into an egg launcher.

pals.name: Melpaca
pals.summary: Don't be fooled by this Pal's fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world.

partnerSkill.name: Pacapaca Wool
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Kingpaca 's Defense and Movement Speed. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Eikthyrdeer
pals.summary: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Forest
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted and increases lumbering efficiency by (220~500)% .

pals.name: Flambelle
pals.summary: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Tears
partnerSkill.description: While in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by (0.1~0.5)% per second outside of combat. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Bristla
pals.summary: This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles while a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.

partnerSkill.name: Princess Gaze
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Grass Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Direhowl
pals.summary: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.

partnerSkill.name: Direhowl Rider
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Moves slightly faster than most mounts.

pals.name: Leezpunk

spawns.location: Map Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 162,-280

pals.summary: A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.

partnerSkill.name: Too Cool to be Seen
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Leezpunk and the player become invisible , making them undetectable to enemies for (10~20) seconds.

pals.name: Flopie
pals.summary: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late.

partnerSkill.name: Helper Bunny
partnerSkill.description: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

pals.name: Jelliette
pals.summary: A Pal that closely resembles Jellroy . It’s very social, so when plans overlap, it asks its good friend Jellroy to go in its place. As thanks, one date.

partnerSkill.name: Jelliette Drop
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases items obtained from fishing by (55~95)% . While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jelliette 's watering speed increases by (50~120)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Leezpunk Ignis
pals.summary: A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.

partnerSkill.name: Too Cool to be Seen
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Leezpunk Ignis and the player become invisible , making them undetectable to enemies for (10~20) seconds.

pals.name: Herbil
pals.summary: When in doubt, punch it till it works—that’s Herbil 's approach to fixing things. With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.

partnerSkill.name: Herbil Pulse
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Herbil uses its healing powers to restore (30~60)% of the player's Max Health when incapacitated.

pals.name: Cinnamoth
pals.summary: Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them.

partnerSkill.name: Mysterious Scales
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Poison Fog . While at a base, increases the Farming Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Caprity
pals.summary: The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.

partnerSkill.name: Berry Picker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when assigned to Ranch . While in party, restores (100~200) Pal's Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Croajiro
pals.summary: Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life. By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch, they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.

partnerSkill.name: Leap Stance
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Croajiro Noct channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While airborne before landing, the player's Attack is increased by (50~86)% .

pals.name: Jellroy
pals.summary: A Pal that closely resembles Jelliette . It sometimes appears as a substitute when Jelliette is unavailable. Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch.

partnerSkill.name: Jellroy Drop
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases items obtained from salvaging by (55~95)% . While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jellroy 's watering speed increases by (50~120)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra
pals.summary: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Golden Forest
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While at a base, increases the Lumbering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 (Does not stack)

pals.name: Galeclaw
pals.summary: A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.

partnerSkill.name: Galeclaw Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables high-speed gliding and allows shooting with the right hand.

pals.name: Nitewing
pals.summary: It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them as a surrogate parent. Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.

partnerSkill.name: Travel Companion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.

pals.name: Gobfin
pals.summary: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Aqua Gun . When this Pal uses Aqua Gun , it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by (10~20)% .

pals.name: Killamari Primo
pals.summary: It sinks its fangs into the enemy’s neck, draining every last drop of blood. When two Killamari Primo s latch onto each other, they become locked in a relentless struggle—each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Killamari
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.

pals.name: Gloopie
pals.summary: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly awkward misunderstandings.

partnerSkill.name: Sticky Princess
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the capture gauge decreases (12~35)% more slowly while the bars are not overlapping during the fishing minigame. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Amione
pals.summary: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For Amione , companionship is everything.

partnerSkill.name: Magical Twin Powers
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Watering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Hangyu Cryst
pals.summary: Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice. There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square and had their hair torn out by Hangyu Cryst as a brutal form of public humiliation.

partnerSkill.name: Winter Trapeze
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding.

pals.name: Foxparks Cryst
pals.summary: It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. When Foxparks Cryst catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Frost
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and attacks using frigid air.

pals.name: Pengullet Lux
pals.summary: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly. Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy— so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Lux Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, the player equips Pengullet Lux to fire Rocket Launcher as ammunition. Pengullet Lux explodes on impact and is incapacitated.

pals.name: Muffly
pals.summary: Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Flutterer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Freeze . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Kelpsea Ignis
pals.summary: Its personality changes depending on the temperature of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality.

partnerSkill.name: Lava Spout
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Fire Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Ribbuny Botan
pals.summary: Always wears a cheerful smile. Sometimes, thanks to Cattiva 's pranks, they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out! Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.

partnerSkill.name: Ground 'n' Pound
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves player's and Pals' Grass damage to enemy weak points by (25~40)% . (Does not stack) Increases efficiency by (200~400)% when working at a Weapon Workbench, Weapon Assembly Line, or other related facilities.

pals.name: Finsider
pals.summary: It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. Perhaps the universe itself lies within.

partnerSkill.name: Water Gun
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Finsider changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack by (30~50)% .

pals.name: Surfent
pals.summary: Its hydrodynamic form is well suited for activities on water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Swimmer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. Sometimes drops Leather when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Gobfin Ignis
pals.summary: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire!

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Spirit Fire . When this Pal uses Spirit Fire , it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by (10~20)% .

pals.name: Needoll
pals.summary: Its spikes react to its emotions. A dearly cherished Needoll is something one may instinctively want to embrace. But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.

partnerSkill.name: Hug Me Please
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Ivy-Covered by (50~65)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Turtacle
pals.summary: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath. Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.

partnerSkill.name: Spikey Carrier
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces Ore weight by (80~100)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Dazzi
pals.summary: Often kind to lonely Pals. However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual friendship, it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Lightning
partnerSkill.description: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Electric bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

pals.name: Snugloo
pals.summary: “To look at a Snugloo 's eyes” is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed whether Snugloo s have eyes in the first place.

partnerSkill.name: Invisible Eye
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Celaray Lux
pals.summary: Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner. But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving Celaray Lux , yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.

pals.name: Cawgnito
pals.summary: Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw , it abandoned the skies, and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.

partnerSkill.name: Eerie Nightstreaker
partnerSkill.description: When activated, grants Night Vision to see in dark places. Activate again to turn off. Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Puffolt
pals.summary: Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked. Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, making bath time together a serious gamble.

partnerSkill.name: Crackle Booster
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Generating Electricity Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Beegarde
pals.summary: A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee . Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.

partnerSkill.name: Worker Bee
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Elizabee 's Attack. Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Tombat
pals.summary: Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.

partnerSkill.name: Ultrasonic Sensor
partnerSkill.description: When activated, uses ultrasonic waves to detect nearby dungeons, treasure chests, and scrap .

pals.name: Chillet
pals.summary: It can curl up its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force.

partnerSkill.name: Wriggling Weasel
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Dragon and increases Attack by (5~20)% .

pals.name: Arsox

spawns.location: Map Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 176,-308

pals.summary: In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Warm Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains Cold Resistance +2 . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Kikit
pals.summary: A decade ago, Kikit soccer was popular. However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from the Free Pal Alliance. Nevertheless, the Kikit 's themselves didn't mind because it helped shed their old carapace.

partnerSkill.name: Sandball Soccer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of Ground Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Fuack Ignis
pals.summary: With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs. But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.

partnerSkill.name: Fire Tackle
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Fuack Ignis fire surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.

pals.name: Dumud
pals.summary: When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.

partnerSkill.name: Soil Improver
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Ground Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Elphidran

spawns.location: Map Free Pal Alliance Tower Entrance 44,-284

pals.summary: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Holy Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, Dark Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Univolt
pals.summary: It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Deity
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Electric damage to weak points by (25~40)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Robinquill
pals.summary: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans in the distant past.

partnerSkill.name: Grounded Archer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's bow damage by (10~35)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Wispaw
pals.summary: The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans who have raised its kind. Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on Wispaw .

partnerSkill.name: Death-Cheating Feline
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate when awarded a back bonus . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Finsider Ignis
pals.summary: Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going. Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher tried climbing in like a sleeping bag. But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized... it’s definitely part of the creature’s body.

partnerSkill.name: Ember Chamber
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Finsider Ignis helps carry supplies, reducing the weight of weapons in your inventory by (60~100)% . Also improves player's and Pals' Fire damage to enemy weak points by (25~40)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Yakumo
pals.summary: It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil. In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders. Nowadays, Yakumo s are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.

partnerSkill.name: Birds of a Feather
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, (15~30)% increased chance of encountering pals with the same Passive Skill as this Pal. (Excludes certain Passive Skills)

pals.name: Kingpaca
pals.summary: Melpaca serve this Pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.

partnerSkill.name: King of Muscles
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by (5~14)% for each Melpaca in party.

pals.name: Dazemu
pals.summary: Take one step forward and forget your doubts. Take two steps forward and forget your worries. Take three steps forward and forget your fears. Face any enemy.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Sprint
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by (50~100)% while mounted on sand .

pals.name: Sweepa
pals.summary: While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101.

partnerSkill.name: King of Fluff
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by (12~24)% for each Swee in party.

pals.name: Gorirat
pals.summary: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases Gorirat 's Attack by (75~300)% for a limited time.

pals.name: Munchill
pals.summary: The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, making it a natural fridge when closed. Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans— whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Maw
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the weight of ingredient and food by (30~60)% . When paired with another Ice Pal, their Rot Speed also reduces by (-30~-80)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Grintale

spawns.location: Map Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 175,-317

pals.summary: Grintale 's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory. This is no figure of speech—its eyes literally light up.

partnerSkill.name: Glaring Cat's Eye
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, picking up a Pal Egg has a (50~75)% chance of receiving one extra. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Loupmoon
pals.summary: The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them.

partnerSkill.name: Dark Gleam Strike
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Jumping Claw . When this Pal uses Jumping Claw , it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed by (15~30)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Dinossom
pals.summary: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The phrase |step on a Dinossom 's tail| has come to mean enraging someone.

partnerSkill.name: Fragrant Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increase Defense of Dragon Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Lovander
pals.summary: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

partnerSkill.name: Heart Drain
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, grants the player and Lovander a life steal effect that restores (5~9)% of damage dealt as Health .

pals.name: Wixen
pals.summary: With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress .

partnerSkill.name: Lord Fox
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Wixen changes the player's attack type to Fire and increases Attack by (30~50)% .

pals.name: Penking

spawns.location: Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 114,-352

pals.summary: Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet . However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly.

partnerSkill.name: Brave Sailor
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Fire Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Mossanda
pals.summary: A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once! It's only by some miracle that this Pal isn't a meat-eater.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

pals.name: Robinquill Terra
pals.summary: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the rocky areas. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.

partnerSkill.name: Master Archer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's bow charge speed by (15~30)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Katress

spawns.location: Map Hidden Passage to the Oculus Gate -1083,-1287

pals.summary: With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen .

partnerSkill.name: Mystical Black Magic
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Neutral Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. Also has a (10~50)% chance to prevent Pal Sphere consumption when thrown. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Woolipop Terra
pals.summary: Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.

partnerSkill.name: Bitter Pop
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Caramel Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch . While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by (-15~-25)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Elgrove
pals.summary: The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come.

partnerSkill.name: Mother Nature's Menace
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Elgrove changes the player's attack type to Grass and increases Attack by (30~50)% .

pals.name: Lunaris
pals.summary: It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control.

partnerSkill.name: Antigravity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, spheres home in on Pals, and carrying capacity increases by (300~600) . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Souffline
pals.summary: Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories. Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.

partnerSkill.name: Fuzzy Fairy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Ivy-Covered . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Lullu
pals.summary: In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island. Flopie 's hay fever is Lullu 's fault.

partnerSkill.name: Floral Boost
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, Lullu fills farms with good spirits, increasing the growth rate of the crops by (50~70)% .

pals.name: Pyrin
pals.summary: Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. If someone rides it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.

partnerSkill.name: Red Hare
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Fire and increases Attack by (5~20)% .

pals.name: Foxcicle
pals.summary: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.

partnerSkill.name: Aurora Guide
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Ice Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Fenglope
pals.summary: In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings. As time passed, its beautiful pelt and antlers were often seen in works of art.

partnerSkill.name: Wind and Clouds
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.

pals.name: Chillet Ignis
pals.summary: It can curl up its body and roll around so fast that sparks fly. Sparks also fly when it feels excited. If you stroke it too much, this pal will get fired up, literally!

partnerSkill.name: Sparkling Weasel
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Fire and increases Attack by (5~20)% .

pals.name: Caprity Noct
pals.summary: The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions. The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become. This is why most Caprity Noct raised in captivity have never known love.

partnerSkill.name: Venom Picker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Venom Gland from its back when assigned to Ranch . While in party, restores (100~200) Pal's Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Reindrix
pals.summary: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen and smashed to pieces.

partnerSkill.name: Cool Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains Heat Resistance +2 . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Rayhound
pals.summary: At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. When two Rayhound s collide, a thunderous roar echoes through the air.

partnerSkill.name: Lightning Shepherd
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding Rayhound )

pals.name: Dazzi Noct
pals.summary: Often kind to lonely Pals, it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down. Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Dark Lightning
partnerSkill.description: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Dark bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

pals.name: Valentail
pals.summary: In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today. For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly ten times its current size within the next century.

partnerSkill.name: Big Stretch
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the effects of gravity on the player, making them more floaty while jumping and falling. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Dinossom Lux
pals.summary: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase |struck by a Dinossom Lux 's bolt| has come to mean narrowly escaping death.

partnerSkill.name: Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Defense of Electric Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Gorirat Terra
pals.summary: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. Stronger than Gorirat , if every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Pound
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's climbing speed by (50~100)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Pyrin Noct
pals.summary: It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Hare
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Dark and increases Attack by (5~20)% .

pals.name: Croajiro Noct
pals.summary: The Croajiro who have forsaken their honor gather and form splinter groups. They will use any underhanded means to take down their chosen prey. If you encounter a pack of Croajiro Noct in the dead of the night, it's your life that's on the line.

partnerSkill.name: Shadow Stance
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Croajiro Noct channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Dark damage to enemy weak points by (25~40)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Penking Lux
pals.summary: Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting. As a result, it lost the affection of Pengullet — but strangely enough, it now has a loyal follower: Pengullet Lux .

partnerSkill.name: Unyielding Storm Commander
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves player's and Pals' Water damage to enemy weak points by (25~40)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Surfent Terra
pals.summary: Its aerodynamic form is well suited for activities on sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Swimmer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks inflict Muddy (2~6) . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Azurobe
pals.summary: This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. This past has left them bitter towards humanity.

partnerSkill.name: Waterwing Dance
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack by (5~20)% .

pals.name: Xenovader
pals.summary: Can send information and convert it into energy by forgetting it. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone. - Respond. Target located. Proceed to immediate destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Unknown Invader
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the damage of the last bullet fired from a full-auto weapon by (100~160)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Sibelyx
pals.summary: A Pal that likes the rain, and will often bask in rain showers until the weather clears up. On rainy days, Foxparks can often be found taking shelter beneath it.

partnerSkill.name: Silk Shroud
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Blizzard Spike . When this Pal uses Blizzard Spike , it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch .

pals.name: Katress Ignis
pals.summary: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. Not on good terms with Wixen Noct .

partnerSkill.name: Blazing Black Magic
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Kindling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Elizabee
pals.summary: A chosen queen to rule over Beegarde s. There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen.

partnerSkill.name: Queen Bee Command
partnerSkill.description: This Pal's Attack increases by (12~24)% for each Beegarde in party.

pals.name: Snock
pals.summary: Tossing an Snock into the bath for a shock spa is considered a traditional health practice. That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.

partnerSkill.name: Charging Shell
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Electrify (2~6) . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Hoodle
pals.summary: When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it's no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps.

partnerSkill.name: Void-Dweller
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat by (50~100)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Smokie
pals.summary: The black flames are merely warm to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

partnerSkill.name: Dig, Smokie! Dig!
partnerSkill.description: When activated, uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby Chromite . While fighting together, Chromite acquisition increases by +(100~200)% .

pals.name: Slowatt
pals.summary: Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.

partnerSkill.name: Chillswitch
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Electrify , the enemy discharges electricity , dealing damage equal to (40~60)% of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

pals.name: Mimog
pals.summary: There was once a tradition of handing out an award to the person who met their end in the most foolish way. The first award was given for |being unaware of Mimog , opening the chest, and being bitten to death.|

partnerSkill.name: Master of Unlocking
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Mimog can open treasure chests without using a key.

pals.name: Tarantriss
pals.summary: Extremely sticky and clingy. The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes. Such is its |personality.|

partnerSkill.name: Tarantriss’ Web
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. Additionally, can shoot spider web to grapple and move at high speed.

pals.name: Petallia
pals.summary: A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.description: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by (75~85)% . While at a base, increases the Planting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Maraith
pals.summary: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why.

partnerSkill.name: Messenger of Death
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, all Party Pals' Active Skill cooldowns are reduced by (30~60)% whenever you defeat an enemy. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Carnibora
pals.summary: Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.

partnerSkill.name: Entangling Tongue
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, Carnibora creates a whirlwind that deals damage to enemies it touches ( Grass / Power: (40~80) ). (Does not stack)

pals.name: Beakon
pals.summary: Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk , but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.

partnerSkill.name: Thunderous
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by (5~20)% . This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon )

pals.name: Lapiron
pals.summary: Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.

partnerSkill.name: Friend of Earth
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's Defense by (50~65)% while sprinting. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Kitsun
pals.summary: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you.

partnerSkill.name: Wolf of the Sun
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Ice damage and are immune to Freeze . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Polapup
pals.summary: Among Polapup s, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky— a common sight during territorial season. Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying Polapup s.

partnerSkill.name: Rider of the Snowy Mountain
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by (80~160)% while mounted on snow . Can also slide quickly down slopes.

pals.name: Vanwyrm
pals.summary: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by (20~40)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Elphidran Aqua
pals.summary: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Water Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Fire damage and are immune to Burn . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Gloopie Primo
pals.summary: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly unnecessary concern.

partnerSkill.name: Cephalo-Princess
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of Water Pals by (15~30)% . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Dumud Gild
pals.summary: Its body reflects light with astounding clarity. Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than Dumud .

partnerSkill.name: Golden Harvest
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases amount of Gold Coin dropped by enemies by +(100~200)% . Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch , with a small chance to drop Gold Coin . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Smokie Cryst

partnerSkill.description: When activated, the player's attacks inflict Poison (2~6) . While in party, grants the player and party Pals immunity to Poison , and nullifies the effects of toxic gas in the World Tree area. (Does not stack)

pals.name: Bastigor
pals.summary: The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it. For Bastigor the toughest challenge, after simply living, is making a snowman.

partnerSkill.name: Blizzard Crash
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with a hammer forged from Ice .

pals.name: Shaolong
pals.summary: Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership.

partnerSkill.name: Azure Sovereign
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack increases by (4~8)% for each other Dragon Pal in your party.

pals.name: Aegidron
pals.summary: In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, the light within Aegidron 's wings was used to send simple flash signals.

partnerSkill.name: Indestructible Fortress
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take (60~80)% less damage from explosive attacks , and are immune to Stun . (Does not stack)

pals.name: Panthalus
pals.summary: The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart. Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled, its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.

partnerSkill.name: Resonant Guardian
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above.

pals.name: Astralym
pals.summary: A shadow of its former self, this mysterious Pal descended upon the Palpagos long ago. Bringing ruin and calamity, it was sealed away for millennia until it was ultimately defeated by a certain Pal Tamer

partnerSkill.description: This Pal's abilities are still being investigated.
